narratives.mechanism: Borrowing costs or capital allocation can affect how much future cash ultimately belongs to shareholders.
narratives.competing_reading: Higher dividends or buybacks can be funded by debt and are not automatically value creation.
narratives.test: Check the balance sheet, debt maturities and cash available after capital spending.

narratives.headline: Marathon Petroleum Corp. stock underperforms Thursday when compared to competitors
narratives.mechanism: A lasting competitive change could alter future demand or the prices the company can charge.
narratives.competing_reading: A competitor announcement does not itself prove customers will switch.
narratives.test: Look for customer wins, product economics and margin changes in company filings.

narratives.headline: Marathon Petroleum Shares Fall as Refining Sector Weakens
narratives.mechanism: Changes in selling prices or operating costs affect the fraction of sales that becomes profit and cash.
narratives.competing_reading: A temporary price or cost improvement may disappear when conditions normalize.
narratives.test: Check reported operating margins, cash conversion and the reasons for changes.
